 Order

This is second application under section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure, for grant of bail filed on behalf of the applicant relating to FIR/Crime No.45/2023 dated 07.02.2023 registered at Police Station- Ramnagar, District- Satna, for the offence punishable under Sections 342, 457, 376 and 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 5l/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: His earlier application being M.Cr.C.No.21572/2023 was dismissed on merits vide order dated 19.06.2023 passed by this Court.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is in custody since 09.02.2023.
He submits that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the present case because it is a case of consent.
He further submits that challan has been filed and the trial will take considerable time to conclude.
Upon these submissions, learned counsel prays that the applicant may be released on bail.

sentences.text: On the contrary, learned counsel for the respondent/State as well as for objector oppose the bail application and prayed for its rejection.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case-diary.

This bail application has been argued on the ground that the prosecutrix, her mother and her grandparents have failed to support the prosecution story, but this fact was considered in the earlier bail application as well,
which was dismissed in M.Cr.C. No.21572/2023 and it was observed that despite consensual relationship of prosecutrix with the applicant the bail application cannot be allowed, as the age of prosecutrix was below 16 years at the time of incident.
The bail application has been supported by the mother of prosecutrix, who is being represented here through her counsel.
For the reason mentioned in the earlier bail order, no objection given by the mother of prosecutrix cannot be the basis of allowing second bail application.
Further, the DNA report has been received in the case and it confirms the sexual relationship between the applicant and the prosecutrix.
For the age of prosecutrix, the State has relied upon her school record and appreciation of evidence on that fact cannot be undertaken by this Court while deciding the bail application.
Having considered all these facts, bail application is hereby dismissed.
(ANURADHA SHUKLA) JUDGE rv Rabi @ Anurag Patel vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/194869982/
